x: Len Best(76) and Martin Lake have both shown remarkable improvement through the winter and have never been far apart at the finish. In this race(The 4th Surrey CC League Match at Coulsdon) Martin turned out the winner but in the Club 10mile Championship Len got the better of Martin.
New member Len Best, who started with the Gorman pack and graduated to 18 milers, surprised more established runners but it was the ever improving Mike Nouch who took gold with Martin Lake third.

He had to work hard to regain the lead from Len Best who had travelled up from his new base in Bristol to compete. Junior Richard O'Hara ran well in his first attempt at this course and took the handicap prize.
